name: imrotate3
expr: B1 = imrotate3(A, 90, [0 0 1]); B2 = imrotate3(A, 90, [1 0 0]); B3 = imrotate3(A, 90, [0 1 0]); B4 = imrotate3(A, 45, [0 0 1]); B5 = imrotate3(A, 45, [0 0 1], 'linear', 'crop'); B6 = imrotate3(A, 60, [1 1 1]); B7 = imrotate3(A, 30, [0 0 1], 'nearest'); B8 = imrotate3(A, 30, [0 0 1], 'cubic'); B9 = imrotate3(A, 0, [0 0 1]); B10 = imrotate3(A, 45, [0 0 1], 'linear', 'loose', 'FillValues', -99);
comment: imrotate3 — 3-D Rodrigues rotation. Covers: axis-aligned 90° around z/x/y, 45° z (loose + crop), oblique 60° around [1 1 1], methods nearest/cubic, identity (angle=0), FillValues NV. Default method='linear', default bbox='loose'. Standard right-hand rule CCW around axis.
